The FMGE Eligibility Certificate is an essential document issued by the National Medical Commission (NMC) for Indian students and Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) who have obtained their MBBS degree from a foreign medical university. This certificate verifies that the candidate fulfills the necessary educational and regulatory requirements set by NMC to appear for the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE), a screening test required for medical licensure in India. ✅ Mandatory for FMGE Registration – Without this document, a candidate cannot apply for FMGE, which is required to practice medicine in India. ✔ Candidates applying for FMGE for the first time and do not have an Eligibility Certificate.
